tag.name: Microsoft Clarity - Consent API V2

parameter.value:
<script>
(function () {
  if (typeof window.clarity !== 'function') return

  var clarityConsent = {{DLV - Consent - Microsoft Clarity}} === true
  var adsConsent = {{DLV - Consent - Google Ads}} === true

  window.clarity('consentv2', {
    source: 'olgish-cakes',
    ad_Storage: adsConsent ? 'granted' : 'denied',
    analytics_Storage: clarityConsent ? 'granted' : 'denied'
  })

  if (!clarityConsent) {
    window.clarity('consent', false)
  }
})()
</script>

tag.notes: Updates Clarity consent on every canonical consent event and revokes consent on withdrawal. This tag does not load Clarity.
